records.title: Wavelet-prior-guided mamba network for accurate and efficient rice disease recognition
records.reason: The Frontiers primary full text describes WPMamba for rice-disease image classification, with wavelet features, Mamba fusion, and lesion-aware attention. It reports 95.72% accuracy, 1.21M parameters, and 0.49 GFLOPs on a rice-disease dataset. The efficiency figures are for an agricultural vision classifier, not LLM inference or serving.
